none: PAS KENT-4B94B2: Roman. Coin. Nummus or AE4 of House of Constantine. Obverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, nummus or AE4 of the House of Constantine. Obverse: Laureate and cuirassed bust right. Inscription: ....AVG. Reverse: Two soldiers holding one standard. Inscription: (GLO)[RIA EXERCITVS]. Minted in Trier. Mint mark: -//TRS[]. Reece period 17. Die axis: 12 o'clock. This coin is in very fine condition with very little wear but two sections of the edge have chipped away. The coin has a green/brown patchy patina and slight surface corrosion. This coin is likely to date to 337-341AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2011, page 62 no. 599A and Identifying Roman Coins, Richard Reece & Simon James, Seaby 1986 reprint 1994, page 28-29…
